validation: All eight native saved visualizations validated on genuine imported data and force-recalculated; recorded in activation.json

dashboard.name: Engineering delivery (repository metadata)
dashboard.description: Public repository CI/PR observations over rolling seven days; refreshed manually. Custom, noncanonical event metrics. No actors, log content, test-flake classifications or runner costs. Native Engineering Analytics source is unavailable; missing imported data means unknown coverage.

insights.name: CI attempt outcomes by week
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. All observed completed attempts, including retries, cancelled, skipped and unknown conclusions. UUID deduplication; only CI workflow, not Release.

source.query:
SELECT
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Jerusalem')) AS week,
    concat(toString(properties.trigger), ' / ', toString(properties.conclusion)) AS outcome,
    count(DISTINCT uuid) AS completed_attempts
FROM events
WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
GROUP BY week, outcome
ORDER BY week, outcome
LIMIT 200

insights.name: Observed completed CI attempt success (%)
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Success divided by all completed observed CI attempts, including cancellations/skips and retries. A run without valid completed-job timestamps is omitted.

source.query:
SELECT
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(completed_at, 'Asia/Jerusalem')) AS week,
    100.0 * countIf(conclusion = 'success') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS success_percent,
    count() AS observed_completed_attempts
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        min(timestamp) AS completed_at,
        any(properties.conclusion) AS conclusion
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week
LIMIT 30

insights.name: CI completed-job span p50/p95 (seconds)
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Earliest completed job start through latest completed job finish, including dependency gaps; initial queue time excluded. All conclusions included; one row per attempt UUID.

source.query:
SELECT
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(completed_at, 'Asia/Jerusalem')) AS week,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_seconds) AS p50_seconds,
    quantile(0.95)(duration_seconds) AS p95_seconds,
    count() AS observed_attempts
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        min(timestamp) AS completed_at,
        max(toFloat(properties.job_span_seconds)) AS duration_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week
LIMIT 30

insights.name: CI job duration p50/p95 (seconds)
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Fixed job classes only; unknown job names become other. All completed conclusions with valid timings included. Parallel job durations are not workflow duration.

source.query:
SELECT job,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_seconds) AS p50_seconds,
    quantile(0.95)(duration_seconds) AS p95_seconds,
    count() AS observed_jobs
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        any(properties.job) AS job,
        max(toFloat(properties.duration_seconds)) AS duration_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_job_completed'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY job
ORDER BY p95_seconds DESC
LIMIT 20

insights.name: App, landing and installer build duration p50/p95 (seconds)
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Allowlisted build steps only; skipped steps excluded, failed/cancelled durations included. Not billed runner time or build cache hit rate.

source.query:
SELECT job, step,
    quantile(0.5)(duration_seconds) AS p50_seconds,
    quantile(0.95)(duration_seconds) AS p95_seconds,
    count() AS observed_build_steps
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        any(properties.job) AS job,
        any(properties.step) AS step,
        max(toFloat(properties.duration_seconds)) AS duration_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_step_completed'
        AND properties.step IN ('app_build', 'landing_build', 'installer_build')
        AND properties.conclusion != 'skipped'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY job, step
ORDER BY job, step
LIMIT 30

insights.name: Repeat CI attempt share (%) — not a flaky-test rate
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Attempts numbered greater than one divided by all observed completed attempts. Retries may reflect infrastructure, cancellation or code changes; no test-level classification.

source.query:
SELECT
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(completed_at, 'Asia/Jerusalem')) AS week,
    100.0 * countIf(attempt > 1) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS repeat_attempt_percent,
    count() AS observed_completed_attempts
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        min(timestamp) AS completed_at,
        max(toInt(properties.attempt)) AS attempt
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week
LIMIT 30

insights.name: Merged PRs by target branch and week
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Bots and currently draft PRs excluded. Separate dev feature work from main release PRs. No per-author breakdown or ranking.

source.query:
SELECT
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Jerusalem')) AS week,
    properties.target_branch AS target_branch,
    count(DISTINCT uuid) AS merged_prs
FROM events
WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_pr_merged'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
GROUP BY week, target_branch
ORDER BY week, target_branch
LIMIT 60

insights.name: PR open-to-merge p50/p95 (hours)
insights.description: Noncanonical. Rolling 7 days; manual import coverage. SQL ignores dashboard date overrides. Merged timestamp minus created timestamp; includes any former draft time and review waiting. Never call this review time or cycle time. Bots/current drafts excluded.

source.query:
SELECT target_branch,
    quantile(0.5)(open_to_merge_seconds) / 3600.0 AS p50_hours,
    quantile(0.95)(open_to_merge_seconds) / 3600.0 AS p95_hours,
    count() AS observed_merged_prs
FROM (
    SELECT uuid,
        any(properties.target_branch) AS target_branch,
        max(toFloat(properties.open_to_merge_seconds)) AS open_to_merge_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_pr_merged'
        AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY target_branch
ORDER BY target_branch
LIMIT 2
